scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green "npm --prefix ai-image-captioner/client run dev" "npm --prefix ai-image-captioner/server run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix ai-image-captioner/client run build && npm --prefix ai-image-captioner/server run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,blue "cross-env NODE_ENV=production PORT=5174 npm --prefix ai-image-captioner/server run start" "cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm --prefix ai-image-captioner/client run preview -- --port 5173 --strictPort"
